Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 414.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 415.73 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €430.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
As to the delivery record and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We appreciate your proposal and the option to extend the contract term to 24 months, which allows us to adjust our pricing.
Taking into account your data on delivery performance and should-cost, we can offer a revised price of €429.36 per unit for the 24-month agreement with 30 days net payment.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown in due course.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
